text:
noah: Quick sync on the Nimbus joint perf sweep with AeroChip. We're trying to finalize the test matrix this week. Thoughts on including a thermally stressed run (fan 60%)? :thinking:
tess: Thermal runs are useful but we must tag them separately. They skew watt-normalized numbers. I suggest baseline (auto-fan), stress (fan 60%), and cold-start (30min idle). Keep N=3 for stress runs, N=5 baseline.
harpreet: Kernel variants: stock, rn-quant, aero-tune-1. Also propose enabling L2 prefetch toggle on one variant to measure memory pressure effect. Keep sequence lengths 512/2048.
dylan: Telemetry: please capture chassis temps, core temps, powerdraw, and the PCIe link width. I'll add a script that snapshots sensors every 5s. Also recommend tagging run_id with hw_revision and bios version.
benchbot: NOTE: Lab booking request created (lab-5) for Fri next week 09:00-17:00 pending facilities clearance.
noah: For reporting, partner requested per-model p95 and energy_per_token. Legal requested anonymized raw logs until publication. We'll need a partner NDA addendum. harpreet can you surface any proprietary flags in aero-tune-1?
harpreet: aero-tune-1 has a closed-source microcode tweak. Partner asked for us to only share aggregated perf metrics, not microcode dumps. We'll honor that.
tess: Important: We'll need to run kernel dry-runs on a staging node. Use `--dry` and `--collect-only` flags. Example: `./bench.py --config tests/aero_nimbus.yaml --kernel aero-tune-1 --dry`
dylan: I'll push the snapshot script to infra: `infra/bench/snapshots/nimbus_snap.sh` and set up a watcher that validates avg_watts and tokens/s. Alerts: avg_watts > 420 -> pager.
noah: Proposed release cadence: internal review by 2026-07-02, partner review by 2026-07-05, marketplace post 2026-07-10. Any blockers?
harpreet: Need partner sign-off on error bars, we use stdev and 95% CI. Also include environmental note: room temps 20 +/-1C.
benchbot: SAFETY: Facilities flagged last-week breaker maintenance on lab-5. Might cause a 48h delay.
noah: Ok fallback: run on dedicated cloud nodes that mirror AeroChip profiles. Tess, can you add a note in the report about cloud-run variance?
tess: Yep, will add a 'methodology' section. Also will include the exact bench commands used.
noah: Action items: noah - confirm facilities by Tue; tess - draft report skeleton and methodology; harpreet - list kernel flags and confirm partner sharing constraints; dylan - upload snapshot script and set pager rules. We'll reconvene Thu 10am.
harpreet: Will compile kernel flag list by EOD Mon.
dylan: Snapshot script pushed and pager configured.
noah: Great. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
